description.tagline: Comfortable holding to keep your shin in place
description.intro: The Pro-Wrap Premier Sock 7.5cm x 4.5m adhesive bandage is designed to keep the shinplates firmly placed during workouts and matches. Its light, porous and soft construction combines a stable hold with the flexibility necessary to accompany the movements of the football.
key_benefits: Well-attached shin guards: Helps keep the protections in position during the game's own movements.
Comfortable contact: Its soft touch allows to use it directly next to the skin without the need for adhesive.
Lightweight and flexible: Its construction adapts to the leg providing support without adding an unnecessary volume.
Preparada para el juego: El material poroso y resistente al agua permite utilizarla durante entrenamientos y partidos.
Reusable use: Its multi-purpose design allows the bandage to be reused in different sessions.
